headline: Cut first, taken back later
sub: two public cases; not a rule
reading: Two timelines on one month axis from January 2024 to December 2025. Klarna, Sweden: in February 2024 the company said its assistant did the work of 700 service agents, by its own estimate; in May 2025 its chief executive said it would invest in human support, and it hired service staff again, 15 months later. Commonwealth Bank of Australia: in July 2025 it cut 45 service jobs for a voice bot; in August 2025, weeks later, it called this an error and said the roles were not redundant. Two public cases, not a rule.

axis.note: One shared month axis; events sit in the middle of their month. Only the month of each event is drawn.
